userInput.description: Story requirements in any language (free text). May include genre hints, theme, setting, character concepts, or an entire brief.

tier.description: Narrative intensity tier. Omit to let the pipeline auto-detect via LLM.

mode.description: Pipeline mode (step sequence). Omit to use tier default (design_auto).

genreCode.description: Explicit genre code from the 94-entry taxonomy (e.g. 'rpg-jrpg'). Skips LLM genre detection when provided.

routeGroup.description: Route group: 'planning' for game design pipeline, 'narrative' for story-only.

routingMode.description: Routing strategy. 'auto' = full LLM detection, 'semi' = tier given / mode auto, 'manual' = both given.

model.description: Override LLM model for this run (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-pro'). Uses NARRATIVE_MODEL env default when omitted.

teamId.description: Custom creative team to bring along, distilled from user-supplied books or an author's body of work. Call narrative:list-teams first and pass an id whose status is 'ready'; other statuses are treated as no team at all. When the user mentions a team via '@', the inserted text carries 'team=<id>'.

storyType.description: Narrative type axis code (call narrative:list-axes for the vocabulary). Omit to let the pipeline infer it from the request text.

storyTheme.description: Narrative theme axis code (call narrative:list-axes for the vocabulary). Omit to let the pipeline infer it. The third axis, narrative structure, is derived server-side from type + theme and cannot be set directly.

entryKey.description: Entry this run belongs to, as returned by narrative:create-entry. Omit and the run mints its own timestamp directory with no _entry.json, which leaves it in the left rail with no recorded parameters. Create the entry first when you want the same entry record the node canvas produces.

activateSeats.description: Off-by-default polish seats to attach after plot generation. Each one rewrites the generated script in place as a new version of the same field. All off by default: three extra LLM passes over the plot layer.
